title: hw-convec: code for "Cloud-to-ground lightning is enhanced during European wet-bulb heatwaves"
description:
Analysis code for "Cloud-to-ground lightning is enhanced during European wet-bulb heatwaves" by Yulin Zou, Jorge Pérez-Aracil, Jürg Luterbacher, Elena Xoplaki and Sancho Salcedo-Sanz.

The code identifies wet-bulb heatwaves in ERA5, combines them with EUCLID cloud-to-ground lightning observations over European land (2006–2025, April–September), and reproduces the fixed-effects occurrence models, the matched environmental comparison, the composites around the first lightning flash, the sensitivity analyses and all figures of the paper.

EUCLID lightning data are licensed and are not included; see the README for data access and instructions to reproduce the results.
